sql_templates:
WITH recent_signals AS (SELECT * FROM signals.signal_log WHERE date_issued >= (SELECT MAX(date_issued) FROM signals.signal_log) - INTERVAL '5 sessions'),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT rs.*, eod.close AS close_price, ss.stage, ss.technical_score, ss.investment_score
    FROM recent_signals rs
    JOIN market.equity_eod eod ON rs.symbol = eod.symbol AND eod.trade_date BETWEEN rs.date_issued AND rs.date_resolved
    JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON rs.symbol = ss.symbol AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_stop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stop_hits, AVG(return_pct) AS avg_return,
AVG(technical_score) AS avg_technical_score, AVG(investment_score) AS avg_investment_score
FROM joined_data
group by symbol
ORDER BY signal_count DESC LIMIT 10;
